nodes.label: Module 15 — Discipline Care Plans
nodes.rationale: The four CoP-driven discipline plans below the IDG layer — Aide POC (418.76), MSW Plan and Spiritual Care Plan (418.64), Volunteer Plan (418.78) — answering the questions M7's IPOC alone cannot: what is this aide doing, who supervises her, and can the hospice prove its volunteer ratio.

nodes.label: Aide Supervisory Visit Attestation (14-day cadence, D3, D4)
nodes.rationale: CoP 418.76(h)(1) is a hard floor tenants may tighten but never loosen. Competitors capture the supervisory visit as a free-form note on a routine RN visit, so surveyors reconstruct it by reading every narrative looking for the phrase 'supervisory visit'; M15 makes it a discrete attestation row linked to an M8 encounter with its own cadence clock, alerts at day 12/14 and an encounter-sign gate at day 16.

nodes.label: Volunteer Compliance Gates as Scheduling Preconditions (D7)
nodes.rationale: The gates are the operational surface CoP 418.78 demands; M15 owns them because it owns the volunteer plan, avoiding a cross-module FK, while M17 only reads at pre-schedule time so the dependency stays single-direction. An expired TB screening flips the volunteer inactive automatically and the scheduler refuses the assignment with VOLUNTEER_GATE_UNMET.

nodes.label: 5% Volunteer Ratio is Hours ÷ Hours, Not Dollars (M15-F04 / D8)
nodes.rationale: §418.78(e) requires volunteer services to equal ≥5% of total patient-care HOURS of paid and contract staff, so numerator and denominator are both hours — minutes ÷ dollars is dimensionally meaningless. Dollars are confined to the separate cost-savings evidence artifact (ARCH-064). The numerator is direct-care volunteer_visit durations plus a typed volunteer_admin_hours source replacing the unexplained manual_adjustment.

nodes.label: Parent-IPOC Reference with Discipline-Only Refinement (D5)
nodes.rationale: A nullable parent_goal_id supports discipline-only additions (a chaplain's family-spiritual-support goal with no IPOC parent) while preserving traceability back to the IPOC; requiring the parent would force the IPOC to anticipate every discipline-only goal, and copying IPOC content into the discipline plan would be a denormalization disaster on IPOC updates.

nodes.label: Per-Plan-Kind RequiredSignerSet, CHHA Acknowledges Not Cosigns (D11)
nodes.rationale: CoP 418.76 has the supervising RN author the POC and the aide acknowledge they will execute it; a cosign would imply equal authorship the regulation does not grant. Chaplain self-sign matches autonomous spiritual-care responsibility, while MSW and Volunteer plans carry an RN cosign for IDG alignment because the RN is the case manager.

nodes.label: family_violence_disclosure_allowed ABAC Predicate (D9)
nodes.rationale: SUD content reuses M7's sud_disclosure_allowed to keep the consent surface unified, but family-violence content has separate state-law gating (mandatory-reporter posture plus non-disclosure to family-member portal users) so it needs its own predicate. Both filter at the SQL WHERE level, never post-fetch, avoiding 'data loaded but UI-hidden' leaks.

nodes.label: No M15 Table Is Partitioned (D13 / M15-F06, ADR-0022 D1.1)
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL requires a partitioned table's unique constraints to include the partition key, which the partial uniques on discipline_care_plan and discipline_assessment would violate. The original 'high-volume, grows unbounded' rationale was factually wrong: a current-state root caps at ≤4 rows per admission, so partitioning was pure cost and would force cross-partition reads on every 'find the current row'.

nodes.label: Five Outbound Seams (DisciplinePlanReader, MswRiskFactorReader, VolunteerComplianceProvider, SupervisoryCadenceReader, DisciplineComplianceProvider)
nodes.rationale: The M7/M9/M10/M11 precedent: the owning module publishes its seams and consumers (M14/M16/M17/M22/M27/M28) wire when they land. M15 cannot be gated on six downstream modules because CoP 418.76 supervisory enforcement is go-live blocking.

nodes.label: M8 Owns Visit Narrative; M15 Owns the Supervisory Attestation (D4)
nodes.rationale: The architecture's DisciplineVisit listing was schematic — the visit encounter lives in M8 per its own type enum. Splitting narrative between M8 and M15 would break the ownership boundary and force M14's aggregator to merge content from two modules; the supervisory attestation is a discrete artifact in CMS surveyor language, so it earns its own row.

nodes.label: Fail-CLOSED Volunteer/Supervisory Gate Semantics During Outage (M15-F11)
nodes.rationale: During a DR degradation the gate denies with an audited override path rather than fail-open booking of non-compliant volunteers.
